texts: So what can the ecosystem detect?
Face recognition. Known people and strangers.
Weapons. The moment one appears in frame, the alarm is raised.
Fights and violence. A scuffle is caught before it escalates.
Smoking. Rule violations on the grounds are logged.
Unknown person. If someone who is not in the database enters the grounds, the system reports it immediately.
And people counting. Who crossed the line in, and who crossed it out.
